shiftLock.slot: Small slot near console shifter base, covered by a plastic cap
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small slot near console shifter base, covered by a plastic cap.
Pry off the cap or cover if present using your ignition key or a small flathead.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Small slot near console shifter base, covered by a plastic cap.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

alerts.warning: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.

issues.title: Known Shift Interlock Failure
issues.detail: Some 2008-2012 Enclave units have known shift interlock solenoid failures where the vehicle becomes stuck in Park even with the car powered on and brake applied. The manual slot override is the primary solution. This is a documented TSB issue.

shiftLock.slot: NO external shift lock slot. Manual park release: remove the trim panel on the DRIVER'S SIDE of the center console (in the driver's footwell, using a flathead screwdriver). Pull the RED RELEASE strap/cable to disengage the park lock. Press brake while pulling. RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST whenever possible.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — battery under hood.
Connect jump pack to battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N on the electronic selector.
WITHOUT POWER — red release method:
Use a flathead screwdriver to remove the trim panel on the DRIVER'S SIDE of the center console in the driver's footwell.
Press the brake pedal firmly.
Pull the RED RELEASE strap/cable to mechanically disengage the park lock.
Vehicle will roll — ensure wheels are chocked first.
NOTE: There is NO accessible slot near the gear selector base on this model.
Apply parking brake. Chock wheels.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack.
Restore power, press brake, select N electronically.
No power: driver's footwell console trim removal + red release pull.
AWD: FLATBED PREFERRED.

shiftLock.slot: GEN 1 (2005-2009): small cap near gear selector base on floor console — pry off, insert flathead, press down. GEN 2 (2010-2016): column-style console shifter — override button hidden under the SILVER TRIM SURROUND around the shifter (may be covered with a small piece of tape). Remove trim surround, insert small screwdriver into the hole to press the button. GEN 3 (2017-2019): electronic shifter — RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST. Battery under hood.
steps: IDENTIFY GENERATION FIRST.
GEN 1 (2005-2009) — FLOOR CONSOLE CAP:
Turn ignition to ON. Locate small cap near selector base on floor console.
Pry off cap. Insert flathead, press firmly DOWNWARD. Press brake. Move to N.
GEN 2 (2010-2016) — COLUMN-STYLE CONSOLE SHIFTER:
Turn ignition to ON. Remove the silver trim surround around the shifter.
Locate the override button hole (may be covered with tape).
Insert a small screwdriver to press and hold the button.
Press brake. Move shifter to N.
GEN 3 (2017-2019) — ELECTRONIC SHIFTER:
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and move electronic selector to N.
Without power: no confirmed cabin override — FLATBED with dollies.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack.
Gen 1: floor console cap, key to ON, press down, press brake, move to N.
Gen 2: silver trim removal + hidden override button.
Gen 3: restore power, electronic selector to N.
FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air.
AWD (eAssist/eAWD): FLATBED PREFERRED.

tow.method: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

alerts.notes: eAssist mild hybrid available on some years: same procedure.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. AWD/4WD: shift TC to 2H first, then lift rear. Flatbed preferred.

alerts.warning: Transfer case must be in 2H/2WD for road towing. 4WD on dry pavement will damage drivetrain.
alerts.notes: Trailblazer-based platform. Electric push-button transfer case on most. Must shift TC to 2WD before road towing.
